These large transfers are currently grouped under 'Miscellaneous / Other' and 'Uncategorized / Needs Review'. Use the Review Queue below to re-classify or exclude them.
calculation_breakdown.formula: Net Cash Flow = Total Inflows − Total Outflows (including unreviewed items)
calculation_breakdown.surplus_formula: Discretionary Surplus = Total Inflows − Fixed Bills − Confirmed Living Expenses

# Bank Statement Spending Analysis Report

**Accounts Analyzed:** State Bank of India Savings ...2495, State Bank of India Savings ...5320, State Bank of India Savings ...8181

### 1. Executive Summary
- **Statement Period:** 2022-12-01 – 2024-01-19
- **Total Inflow (Income/Deposits):** ₹5,273,174.00
- **Total Outflow (Actual Spending):** ₹4,936,009.57
- **Net Cash Flow (Surplus):** +₹337,164.43
- **Savings / Retention Rate:** 6.4%

### 2. Category Breakdown Table
| Category | Total Spent | % of Total Spend | Top 3 Merchants / Drivers |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Miscellaneous / Other | ₹3,292,823.60 | 66.7% | Cash Withdrawal (Cheque) (₹1,600,000.00), Bank Account Transfer (₹1,500,000.00), ATM Cash Withdrawal (₹188,823.60) |
| Uncategorized / Needs Review | ₹939,663.76 | 19.0% | NEFT Transfer (₹615,137.76), Bank Account Transfer (₹217,960.00), HDFC Bank Transfer (IMPS) (₹51,000.00) |
| Housing & Utilities | ₹602,655.00 | 12.2% | Arshita  Lifespaces Llp (₹600,000.00), SBI Safe Deposit Locker Rent (₹2,655.00) |
| Groceries | ₹55,024.71 | 1.1% | Ratnadeep Super Market (₹38,353.67), Reliance Retail Ltd (₹9,070.04), Rel Retail Ltd-Tr (₹7,601.00) |
| Shopping & Discretionary | ₹28,766.00 | 0.6% | Life Style Internation (₹12,111.00), Jvr Retails Pvt Ltd (₹6,522.00), Mebaz (₹3,999.00) |
| Healthcare & Medical | ₹8,200.00 | 0.2% | Sathya Diagnostic Cent (₹7,000.00), Sri Maruthi Herbals (₹1,200.00) |
| Transportation | ₹5,189.00 | 0.1% | Metro Brands Limited Kv (₹5,189.00) |
| Debt Service | ₹3,540.00 | 0.1% | SBI Gold Loan Service (₹3,540.00) |
| Entertainment & Subscriptions | ₹147.50 | 0.0% | ATMCard AMC 459156*1840 (₹147.50) |
| Dining Out & Food Delivery | ₹0.00 | 0.0% | None |
| **Total Outflow** | **₹4,936,009.57** | **100%** | — |

### 3. Recurring Subscriptions & Fixed Costs Detected
- No recurring subscription or fixed utility commitments detected in the provided period.

### 4. Key Observations & Actionable Insights
#### Top Outflow Drivers
- #1 Miscellaneous / Other: ₹3,292,823.60 (66.7% of total spend) — Primary drivers: Cash Withdrawal (Cheque) (₹1,600,000.00), Bank Account Transfer (₹1,500,000.00)
- #2 Uncategorized / Needs Review: ₹939,663.76 (19.0% of total spend) — Primary drivers: NEFT Transfer (₹615,137.76), Bank Account Transfer (₹217,960.00)
- #3 Housing & Utilities: ₹602,655.00 (12.2% of total spend) — Primary drivers: Arshita  Lifespaces Llp (₹600,000.00), SBI Safe Deposit Locker Rent (₹2,655.00)

#### Anomalies / Spikes
- ₹1,000,000.00 • Bank Account Transfer on 2023-10-09 (Miscellaneous / Other) [Possible Internal Transfer] — Triggered Rule: Amount is 20.9× average transaction size (₹47,922.42).
- ₹600,000.00 • Arshita  Lifespaces Llp on 2023-11-02 (Housing & Utilities) [Possible Internal Transfer] — Triggered Rule: Amount is 12.5× average transaction size (₹47,922.42).
- ₹600,000.00 • Cash Withdrawal (Cheque) on 2023-08-30 (Miscellaneous / Other) [Possible Internal Transfer] — Triggered Rule: Amount is 12.5× average transaction size (₹47,922.42).
- ₹500,000.00 • Cash Withdrawal (Cheque) on 2023-08-16 (Miscellaneous / Other) [Possible Internal Transfer] — Triggered Rule: Amount is 10.4× average transaction size (₹47,922.42).
- ₹500,000.00 • Bank Account Transfer on 2023-10-19 (Miscellaneous / Other) [Possible Internal Transfer] — Triggered Rule: Amount is 10.4× average transaction size (₹47,922.42).

#### Optimization Opportunities
- **Liquid Surplus Retention**: With positive net surplus, route discretionary remainder into a high-interest savings or liquid mutual fund to maximize compound returns on unspent capital.

### 5. Security & Privacy Guardrails
- **Redaction Verification:** All bank account numbers have been masked to last 4 digits only (e.g., `Savings ...1234`). Full SSNs, PAN, Aadhaar, routing/IFSC numbers, and residential street addresses have been scrubbed.
- **Data Integrity Verified:** All category totals sum to exactly ₹4,936,009.57 (100% of total outflow). Internal transfers (0 transactions) and double-counted credit card payoffs have been excluded.
